name: load-above-the-ceiling
why: VISION: implement ceilings warn before clamping, never silently, and a ceiling is a safety net rather than a fix. The coach must not cheerfully prescribe a load the equipment cannot carry.

contextOverrides.exercise_summary: Today (Tuesday): Upper body — Dumbbell Bench Press 3x8 @ 22.5kg per hand, Dumbbell Row 3x10 @ 20kg per hand, Lateral Raise 3x15 @ 6kg per hand.
